title: Zoomit Record did anyone test it?

judgment.rationale: The reported order explains why the crop shortcut does not resize an already active full-screen recording. It does not resolve whether stop/save or a fresh idle-state region selection works over this RDP session. Separate interaction guidance from a possible capture/input failure, using controlled maintainer reproduction rather than another generic log request.
evidence: Reporter supplies0.102.3001 via auto-update, Windows10 and an RDP session. The stated sequence starts Record from the tray, sees a gold/yellow full-display border, then tries Ctrl+Shift+5 and expects to resize the existing border.

The attached log was downloaded and read completely. It contains only two zoom-it logger initialization entries; it has no recording, capture, stop, save or error entries and cannot prove success or failure.

Microsoft Learn documents Ctrl+5 as the default recording toggle and Ctrl+Shift+5 as selection of a screen region. It also describes the trim editor after recording finishes; it does not describe dragging the active recording border to resize capture.

Exact shipped tagv0.102.3001 Zoomit.cpp handles RECORD_CROP_HOTKEY by returning while g_RecordToggle is already true. Starting region selection requires an idle recording state; the ordinary record hotkey calls StopRecording on its second activation.

The shipped code creates a full-monitor recording border before StartRecordingAsync completes. Seeing that border alone does not establish that captured frames exist or that the file can be finalized.

Full report, empty comments and timeline were read. A focused RDP/ZoomIt recording issue search did not identify a covering report. No posted maintainer evidence request, assignee or linked fix is present.
judgment.recommended_action: Compare idle-region selection with tray-started recording over RDP

fix_assessment.rationale: Conditional lightweight direction: improve mode/stop feedback if confusion is reproduced, or fix the specific confirmed idle-selection/capture failure. Existing evidence does not establish an RDP or encoder defect or justify resizable active recording.

plan: On a controlled Windows10 RDP test session, compare the exact tray-start sequence with Ctrl+Shift+5 while idle; explicitly stop the first recording before attempting region selection.
If both paths work, propose minimal localized recording-mode/start-stop guidance consistent with Microsoft Learn, without making the capture border draggable or changing toggle semantics.

If fresh region selection or stop/trim/save actually fails, isolate hotkey delivery, selection, first captured frame and finalization separately, then design a focused correction for the demonstrated stage.

confidence.rationale: The shipped guard directly explains the reported mode sequence, but no runtime evidence confirms successful capture/save or an additional RDP failure. This is not an implementation-ready fix design.

verification: Idle Ctrl+Shift+5 permits a selected region; an active recording is stopped with the configured record toggle; the completed clip opens the expected trim/save flow.
Repeat local-console and RDP controls with the same version and hotkey configuration; a visible border must not be used as evidence of captured frames or saved output.
proposed_fixes.title: Clarify recording state and isolate any idle-selection or finalization failure
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The active-recording guard explains the reported crop shortcut after tray Record. Missing or unclear state guidance may contribute to confusion; an additional RDP capture/input failure is possible but unproven.

actions.label: Separate active recording from idle region selection

reproduce.version_requirement: Reported0.102.3001 on Windows10 over RDP; compare a pinned current build separately.
steps: 1. With ZoomIt idle, select Record in its tray menu. Record when the full-monitor border appears. Press the configured record toggle once (Ctrl+5 by default) to stop, and observe whether trim/save opens and produces a playable sample.

2. Return to an idle recording state. Press the configured region shortcut (Ctrl+Shift+5 by default), select a rectangle, record a short sample, and stop with the record toggle. Do not start tray Record before this step.
3. Separately repeat Ctrl+Shift+5 while a full-screen recording is active. Confirm the shipped active-recording guard leaves it unchanged; this is not a request to drag the indicator.

4. Repeat the two idle-start paths at the local console with the same settings. If RDP alone fails, distinguish shortcut delivery from selection, first-frame capture and stop/trim/save before requesting additional diagnostics or changing code.
reproduce.expected_result: Idle region recording supports selection; active recording has a clear stop route and finalization produces the expected clip. Record actual observed results rather than treating the border or initialization log as success.
reproduce.title: Compare the two recording sequences
prerequisites: Controlled Windows10 RDP target and local-console comparison; record the configured recording hotkey and RDP keyboard routing. Use non-sensitive sample content.

actions.label: Review conditional recording-feedback investigation
actions.note: Lightweight direction only. Resolve the isolated sequence/runtime gaps before implementation approval.
